How to turn a voice note into a job quote with AI (copy the prompt)

You price the job on site, then the quote sits in your head for days. Instead: talk it through on the drive home, dictate it into your notes app, and let AI do the typing.

The prompt:

"Turn this voice-note transcript into a clear job quote for my customer. Sections: Job summary, Work included, Price (only use numbers I say), Timing, Next step. Plain English. Anything unclear: list it as a question for me at the end, don't guess. Transcript: [PASTE]"

I tried it on an example painting job. It sorted the rambling into summary, work, price and timing, and it only used the numbers in the transcript. Best part: it asked about the stairs and the skirting instead of guessing.

Before you send: check every number, answer the questions, add the customer's details back in.
